chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from 'Abd Allah ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said: There is no taslim in the salat over the deceased.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer; here, the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.تَسْلِيمٌ: the concluding salutation ending a prayer

ai.seo_question: Is there taslim in the funeral prayer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the funeral prayer: it does not include taslim at its conclusion. It is relevant to the fiqh of salat over the deceased and clarifies a distinct ruling for this act of worship.
